  SELECT tpep_pickup_datetime, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM trips
  GROUP BY tpep_pickup_datetime
)

       CAST(SUM(n) AS BIGINT) AS trips
FROM timestamp_counts
GROUP BY 1"},{"query_id":"q01","reason":"Lineage: supplied q01 parent; accepted descendant SQL was not supplied.          PARTITION BY EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime)
       ) AS trips
FROM trips"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Lineage: supplied q05 parent; accepted descendant SQL was not supplied.        ) AS trips
